# Auto Loans: payoff quote validity and lien release timing

This quick reference covers two closing-related settings of each Auto Loans product at PCB: how many calendar days a payoff quote remains good (with per-diem interest added through the payoff date), and within how many business days after payoff the lien release is sent.

| Auto Loans product | Payoff quote good for (calendar days) | Lien release sent within (business days after payoff) |
|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 10 | 10 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 10 | 10 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 10 | 10 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 10 | 10 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 10 | 10 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 10 | 10 |

## Reading the two figures correctly

| Setting | Unit | What it counts |
|---|---|---|
| Payoff quote validity | calendar days | how far ahead a payoff quote may state the payoff amount, with per-diem interest added through the payoff date |
| Lien release timing | business days | the time after the loan is paid off by which the lien release is sent |

**Wrong reading:** "both figures are 10, so both count the same kind of day." **Correct reading:** the quote validity counts calendar days, while the lien release counts business days.
